Dialog_SavePresetHint: Saves the gain, EQ, noise suppression and noise gate settings.
Gate_Off: Off — the mic is never muted
Graph_Bypassed: Boost is OFF — audio passes through unchanged
Graph_SimpleHint: Drag up or down to set the gain
Help_NoiseGate: Mutes the mic below the threshold. Drag the marker just above your background noise.
Help_NoiseSuppression: Removes fans, keystrokes and room noise even while you speak.
Help_Text: Double-click to add · Drag to move · Scroll to change width · Right-click for options
Hint_ChooseOutput: Choose a virtual cable (e.g. VB-CABLE Input) as the output, then select its other end as the microphone in Discord, OBS, etc.
Hint_OutputIsSpeakers: The output is your default playback device; you may hear yourself.
Hint_SimpleMode: Simple mode applies only the gain. Switch to Equalizer to shape the tone.
Msg_DeviceProfileNameRequired: Please enter a device profile name.
Msg_DeviceProfileOverwrite: A device profile named '{0}' already exists and will be overwritten.
Msg_PresetOverwrite: A preset named '{0}' already exists and will be overwritten.
Msg_StartupFailed: Failed to change the startup setting: {0}
Msg_StartupPathFailed: Failed to register startup: could not determine the executable path.
Msg_UnsavedChangesHint: Switching presets replaces the current settings.
Presets_Empty: No presets yet. Use "Save as new" to keep your current sound.
Settings_CloseToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
Status_MissingHint: Routing resumes automatically when the device is connected again.
Tip_Boost: Turns gain and EQ on or off (noise suppression and the gate stay as set)
Tip_Ceiling: The limiter keeps the output peaks below this level.
Tip_NS_HighQuality: DeepFilterNet3 (AI). The cleanest, most natural voice, but uses several times the CPU of Standard. Adds 40 ms latency.
Tip_NS_Light: Spectral noise reduction. Almost no CPU; best on steady noise such as fans, air conditioning or hiss. Adds 10 ms latency.
Tip_NS_Standard: RNNoise (AI). Also catches keystrokes and other sudden noise. Adds 10 ms latency.
Tip_Revert: Go back to the saved preset
Tip_UnlockLimit: Raises the gain limit from +50 dB to +100 dB
